descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S01 Hospital search by each field: name, room, MRN, diagnosis

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician; one Hospital patient whose name, room, MRN or diagnosis holds a unique token (one test per field)

When Type part of the token in upper case with spaces around it, then a no-match string, then press Clear search

Then Only that patient is listed; the no-match string lists no patient and shows a no-match message; Clear empties the box and the patient is back

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: token's patient visible and exactly one card; no card for the no-match string; search box empty and card visible after Clear (U1). Needs precondition P1

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
